happening: Bitcoin is FLAT — going up and down in place — resting (+0 dollars this window). No model has called yet this window; they usually speak 2–3 minutes in. 1 minutes 19 seconds left in the window.
ruler: How the wave word is picked (the desk's ruler, from this window's own price trail): FLAT = moved less than $40 total and ended within $15 of where it started. ROLLERCOASTER = changed direction 3+ times without getting anywhere. CLIMBING / FALLING = ended $15+ above / below the start without whipping back. Book tells come from the order-book ladder RIPTIDE polls — the desk has no trade-size tape, so this board never claims 'whales'; it says what the book shows.
